summary: Button variant="inverse" draws its focus outline in --ui-text-inverse, the band's own ink, instead of --ui-border-focus. The page's focus colour measured 2.88:1 against --ui-bg-inverse in light and 1.37:1 in dark (blue-80 on the paper band of the warm-ink dark ramp), so a keyboard-focused inverse button had no visible ring in dark. The band's ink is 15.53:1 in both schemes and needs no new token. Closes the Measured gap on the Inverse grounds sheet (#36) for Button; other controls placed on an inverse band still take the page's focus colour. Browser test added.
